About Event

​30 real businesses. 30 teams. One real problem each. All built on Converge.AI. We mean BUSINESS!

​Most hackathons hand you a made-up prompt. Converge.AI is handing you a real business.

​30 real businesses (restaurants, retail shops, booking services, sales and customer-service teams) each bring one problem they actually want solved. Each team is matched with one business and has about 30 hours to build a working AI solution on Converge.AI, an AI-native work & business platform. The top 8 teams demo live at Stanford in front of the business owners, investors, industry judges and the Converge.AI team.

​👉 Builders: after registering on Luma, have one person per team submit the team form so we can match you with a business (takes about 3 minutes).

Submit your team form →

​💼 For businesses: bring us your problem

​Got a task that eats your team’s time, like answering the same customer questions, following up on leads, handling bookings or writing product content? Hand it to a team powered by Converge.AI.

​What you do:

​Submit one real problem AS SOON AS POSSIBLE: chenxi.huang1028@gmail.com

​Join one short 1:1 call with the Converge.AI team (Nov 9–13) to scope it

​Answer a few questions from your team during the build (Nov 17–18)

​Join us at Demo Day on Nov 20 and pick the Brand’s Choice winner

​What you will get:

​A working AI solution built on Converge.AI for your business, free of charge

​A chance to pilot the best solutions with Converge.AI

​Exposure to builders, investors and media

​🛠️ For builders: build with Converge.AI, ship something that gets used

​Who: Anyone who wants to ship AI that real businesses will use: students, professionals, founders and indie builders. 100% free to join. You don't need to be a student or have a .edu email

​Teams: 3–4 people. Come with a team, or apply solo and we’ll help you find one

​Matching: Teams are matched to businesses by random draw, one team per business

​What you will get: Full access to Converge.AI’s products (Covey, Enter, Framia and Combos), mentorship from the Converge.AI team during the build, and a real business owner waiting to use what you make

​Apply by: Nov 13

​📅 Timeline

​Nov 13 (Fri) · Applications close

​Nov 17 (Tue) morning · Teams matched, challenge briefs released

​Nov 17–18 · Build sprint with Converge.AI mentor office hours

​Nov 18 (Wed) 5:00 PM PT · Submission deadline

​Nov 18–19 · Online judging (Round 1)

​Nov 19 (Thu) afternoon · 8 finalists announced

​Nov 20 (Fri) · Demo Day at Stanford 🎤

​💥 Demo Day agenda · Fri, Nov 20 · 2:30–6:40 PM

​2:30 PM · Doors open · Showcase wall of all 30 projects built on Converge.AI

​2:50 PM · Opening

​3:00 PM · Keynote from Converge.AI: Building the AI-native company

​3:15 PM · Panel: What real businesses need from AI (business owners × investors × Converge.AI)

​3:45 PM · Finalist demos, Teams 1–4

​4:45 PM · Break · Audience voting opens

​5:00 PM · Finalist demos, Teams 5–8

​6:00 PM · Tea break · Judges deliberate

​6:20 PM · Awards, presented by Converge.AI

​6:35 PM · Group photo

​6:40 PM · Networking

​Each finalist team gets 15 minutes: the business problem they solved, a live demo, and judges’ Q&A.

​🏆 $5,000 in prizes, including cash and TikTok credits & token credits. Top solutions will be considered for pilots with their businesses and Converge.AI.

​· $2,000 in cash
· $3,000 in TikTok ad credits

​⚖️ Judges

​

​Presented by Converge.AI

​In partnership with AWS, TikTok, 2%Tech, wefluens, Adal, LightHouse, Canopy and onepiece labs
